{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

df['biomarker_baseline'] = pd.to_numeric(df['biomarker_baseline'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the result
df_dedup.shape"}
